results.title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar in India’s plans for 2027 ODI World Cup after making his T20I comeback
results.description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar is reportedly in India’s plans for the 2027 ODI World Cup. The senior pacer made his comeback in the T20I side after 4 years as he was picked in the squad for the New Zealand series on Tuesday.

results.title: Battle-tested Merritt Island dominates Viera in sweep
results.description: Merritt Island swept Viera in its final home match of the regular season with its three-headed attack and strong serving and setting from Amber Ives.

results.title: Brandon Miller Day-To-Day With Shin Contusion
results.description: Brandon Miller suffered a shin contusion in practice and is day-to-day, according to the Charlotte Hornets. The Hornets announced on Monday that Coby White is set to miss the entire preseason with a left calf strain. The team is already without Kon Knueppel , who will miss the start of the regular season with a hamstring strain. Grant Williams will also miss preseason with a right hamstring injury.

results.title: From WNBA playoffs to College GameDay, the Caitlin Clark Effect is clear
results.description: Caitlin Clark’s ability to drive audience remains one of the most consistent forces in sports television. Two recent data points, one from the WNBA playoffs and one from college football’s premier pregame show, underscore how her presence continues to move the needle across different platforms and sports entirely.
